<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>capture-repeatable-work</code></p>

Extract repeated workflow friction from conversation evidence and propose the smallest durable carrier without implementing it.

## When to use

Extract repeated workflow friction from supplied or available conversations and propose the smallest durable carrier without implementing it. Use only when explicitly requested.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link capture-repeatable-work --scope user
```

The standard destination is `~/.agents/skills`. Codex reads this universal Agent Skills location directly.

### Claude compatibility

```text
arcantry skills link capture-repeatable-work --scope user --compat claude
```

This keeps the universal link and adds a Claude alias to the same canonical package.

## Examples

### Find repeated manual work

**Prompt**

> Use the capture-repeatable-work skill on my five recent completed project tasks and find recurring manual verification steps.

**Expected outcome**

A small set of evidence-backed candidates routed to the narrowest useful instruction, script, skill, or automation.

### Assess one expensive workflow

**Prompt**

> Use the capture-repeatable-work skill on this conversation and decide whether the workflow is stable enough to productize.

**Expected outcome**

A read-only candidate or a clear rejection when the evidence shows only an isolated lapse or transient incident.
